description: Use this when an owner message should wake the agent within seconds. Idempotent. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (required), url (public http or https URL, required unless enabled is false), headers (optional; up to 5 extra headers named Authorization or X-*; omit them on a later call to keep the stored headers; pass an empty object to clear them), enabled (optional boolean; false deletes the wake webhook). Returns {object:"inbox_wake", inbox_id, enabled:true, webhook} on create (HTTP 201, secret revealed once) or update (HTTP 200, secret redacted). enabled false returns {object:"inbox_wake", inbox_id, enabled:false, deleted}. The hook is registered for task.received, owner.reply, and chat.message on that inbox. One owner message produces one POST of task.received. The body includes related [{type, id}] for owner.reply and, for an app message, chat.message. The event log still stores each type. A webhook created with POST /api/v1/webhooks still receives every event it lists. A second call for the same inbox updates the same hook. Localhost and private addresses are rejected. If this client can receive a callback, events/subscribe for message.received is cheaper and needs no URL.

enabled.description: Set false to delete the wake webhook for this inbox. Omit or true to register or update it.

headers.description: Up to 5 extra headers sent on delivery. Names must be Authorization or X-*. Omit to keep stored headers. An empty object clears them. Values are stored encrypted and returned as redacted.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address

url.description: Public https URL that receives the wake POST. Required unless enabled is false.

name: cooper_enable_instant_replies
title: Enable instant replies
